_comment: Contract shared by the TypeScript normalizer (app, repair path) and the Python normalizer (collector, capture path). Both MUST produce identical output for every case. Each case: raw input -> expected normalized output. Real vendor volatility, drawn from what actually changes between two identical polls of an unchanged device.

cases._note: Two bare `!` remain after dropping the ntp clock-period line; they collapse to one. Compare with cisco_ios_unchanged_device_two_polls_match - both MUST land on identical text.
